name: Skills Lab: seeded skills, their preview and the skill editor
description: Loads /skills and confirms the seeded Test Quality Reviewer skills render as cards; opens a skill's side preview (the block the agent receives), then the skill editor, which shows the agent linking it and the version history. Read-only: nothing is saved. Section labels are upper-cased by CSS and agent-browser matches rendered text, so the steps wait on texts without text-transform; clicks target role-bearing elements (cards are role=button, the drawer action is a button).
